newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike estimates raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co raised its earnings estimates on Nike Inc for fiscal 1997 to $5.15 a share from $4.95, and for fiscal 1998 to $6.05 from $5.80.
-- raised its 12- to 18-month price target to $130-$140. Gruntal did not specify its previous target
-- said revenues will likely increase more than expenses in the next six months on higher-than-expected future orders and significant price increases in footwear.
-- said the company maintains an unprecedented brand in footwear and still has vast global potential.
-- shares of the Beaverton, Ore.-based company were 2-1/4 higher at 123-7/8 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
